abstract: Rectal cysts are uncommon, with a search of the medical literature revealing only 12 reported cases. This is in contrast with postanal and sacrococcygeal dermoids which, although still uncommon, appear to occur more frequently. This paper describes a case involving a dermoid cyst arising in the lateral wall of the rectum and reviews the recorded cases of rectal cysts.
abstract_ja: 直腸の嚢胞は稀であり、既報は12例のみである。一方、肛門後部および仙尾部の類皮嚢腫はより多く、やや頻度が高い。本論文は、直腸側壁に生じた類皮嚢腫の症例を報告し、既報の直腸嚢胞症例をレビューする。
